rationale: Engine sets has_zero_optimizer_state = zero_optimization() or bfloat16_enabled(); when bf16+ZeRO0 the flag is True but no ZeRO state actually exists, causing wrong checkpoint save/load path. Detection reads engine state flag and asserts it matches zero_optimization() (single-value, anti-example 12: value_equality not completeness). Layer is schema_topo_precond — single rank but precond guard is 'bf16 enabled with zero_stage=0'. P7 (module/engine state flag) over P4 (dtype/shape). check_stage=init: the wrong flag is set during deepspeed.initialize before step 0 (anti-example 10). Tier 6 because zero_stage flag is in Tier 6 supplements.
